package.name: c3po_perception
package.description:
C3PO's half of the nav container: the FAST-LIO2 -> Nav2 frame adapter (g1_odom_tf), the D7 world-model handover (world_model_publisher), and the launch/config staging that decides which sensors a bring-up claims.
Everything here runs on DDS domain 42, which is unicast on `lo`. Nothing in this package actuates: Nav2's velocity leaves on /c3po/cmd_vel and only apps/bridge turns it into leg motion (docs/DECISIONS.md D2.1).
